name: Blackboard
description: Clean dark theme with zinc palette, subtle borders, and minimal motion — inspired by shadcn/ui
styleGuidance: Clean dark zinc — near-black background, subtle card surfaces with 1px borders, no glow or bloom effects. Motion is understated: simple opacity fades with minimal scale. Typography is clean Inter with tight tracking. Orange accent for primary highlights, blue for secondary data. Follows shadcn/ui design language.
